"""Mission analysis: osculating-element history, two-body vs J2 comparison, parameter sweeps, numerical validation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import numpy as np

from .constants import MU, RE, DEG, OMEGA_E
from .elements import (ClassicalElements, rv_to_coe, kepler_propagate, j2_secular_rates, sun_sync_inclination,
                       circular_velocity, vis_viva, period)
from .propagators import propagate, invariants_drift, convergence_study


def orbit_summary(el: ClassicalElements) -> dict:
    """Derived scalar orbit parameters (km, km/s, s)."""
    rates = j2_secular_rates(el.a, el.e, el.i)
    isso = sun_sync_inclination(el.a, el.e)
    return {"a_km": el.a, "e": el.e, "i_deg": math.degrees(el.i), "raan_deg": math.degrees(el.raan), "argp_deg": math.degrees(el.argp),
            "nu_deg": math.degrees(el.nu), "perigee_alt_km": el.perigee_alt, "apogee_alt_km": el.apogee_alt,
            "period_min": el.period / 60.0, "mean_motion_rev_day": 86400.0 / el.period,
            "v_perigee_kms": vis_viva(el.rp, el.a), "v_apogee_kms": vis_viva(el.ra, el.a),
            "v_circular_kms": circular_velocity(el.a), "energy_km2s2": el.energy,
            "h_km2s": math.sqrt(MU * el.p), "raan_rate_deg_day": math.degrees(rates["raan_dot"]) * 86400,
            "argp_rate_deg_day": math.degrees(rates["argp_dot"]) * 86400,
            "sso_inclination_deg": None if isso is None else math.degrees(isso)}


def osculating_series(y) -> dict:
    """Osculating elements along a trajectory (degrees, km). `u` = argument of latitude (robust for circular orbits)."""
    n = len(y)
    out = {k: np.empty(n) for k in ("a", "e", "i", "raan", "argp", "nu", "u")}
    for k in range(n):
        el = rv_to_coe(y[k, :3], y[k, 3:])
        out["a"][k], out["e"][k] = el.a, el.e
        out["i"][k], out["raan"][k] = math.degrees(el.i), math.degrees(el.raan)
        out["argp"][k], out["nu"][k] = math.degrees(el.argp), math.degrees(el.nu)
        out["u"][k] = (out["argp"][k] + out["nu"][k]) % 360.0
    return out


def _secular_slope_deg_per_day(t, ang_deg):
    return float(np.polyfit(t, np.degrees(np.unwrap(np.radians(ang_deg))), 1)[0] * 86400.0)


def compare_twobody_j2(r0, v0, duration_s, dt_s=60.0, method="dop853") -> dict:
    """Propagate the same state with both force models; report separation growth and secular drifts."""
    tb = propagate(r0, v0, duration_s, dt_s, "twobody", method)
    j2 = propagate(r0, v0, duration_s, dt_s, "j2", method)
    d = j2.r - tb.r
    el0 = rv_to_coe(r0, v0)
    osc_tb, osc_j2 = osculating_series(tb.y), osculating_series(j2.y)
    ana = j2_secular_rates(el0.a, el0.e, el0.i)
    out = {"t": tb.t, "sep_km": np.linalg.norm(d, axis=1), "twobody": tb, "j2": j2, "osc_twobody": osc_tb, "osc_j2": osc_j2,
           "final_sep_km": float(np.linalg.norm(d[-1])), "max_sep_km": float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(d, axis=1))),
           "raan_rate_analytical_deg_day": math.degrees(ana["raan_dot"]) * 86400,
           "argp_rate_analytical_deg_day": math.degrees(ana["argp_dot"]) * 86400}
    if duration_s >= 0.5 * el0.period:
        out["raan_rate_measured_deg_day"] = _secular_slope_deg_per_day(j2.t, osc_j2["raan"]) if el0.i > 1e-3 else 0.0
        if el0.e > 0.01:
            out["argp_rate_measured_deg_day"] = _secular_slope_deg_per_day(j2.t, osc_j2["argp"])
    return out


def parameter_sweep(base: ClassicalElements, parameter: str, values, numeric_days: float = 0.0):
    """pandas.DataFrame version of `parameter_sweep_rows` (pandas is imported only here)."""
    import pandas as pd
    return pd.DataFrame(parameter_sweep_rows(base, parameter, values, numeric_days))


def parameter_sweep_rows(base: ClassicalElements, parameter: str, values, numeric_days: float = 0.0) -> list[dict]:
    """Sweep altitude (circular, km), inclination (deg) or eccentricity (perigee altitude held).
    Analytical metrics always; optional numerical J2-vs-two-body separation after `numeric_days`."""
    rows = []
    for v in values:
        if parameter == "altitude_km":
            el = ClassicalElements(RE + v, base.e, base.i, base.raan, base.argp, base.nu)
        elif parameter == "inclination_deg":
            el = ClassicalElements(base.a, base.e, v * DEG, base.raan, base.argp, base.nu)
        elif parameter == "eccentricity":
            rp = base.rp; el = ClassicalElements(rp / (1 - v), v, base.i, base.raan, base.argp, base.nu)
        else:
            raise ValueError("parameter must be altitude_km, inclination_deg or eccentricity")
        s = orbit_summary(el)
        row = {parameter: v, "period_min": s["period_min"], "v_perigee_kms": s["v_perigee_kms"], "v_apogee_kms": s["v_apogee_kms"],
               "energy_km2s2": s["energy_km2s2"], "perigee_alt_km": s["perigee_alt_km"], "apogee_alt_km": s["apogee_alt_km"],
               "raan_rate_deg_day": s["raan_rate_deg_day"], "argp_rate_deg_day": s["argp_rate_deg_day"],
               "sso_inclination_deg": s["sso_inclination_deg"]}
        if numeric_days > 0:
            r0, v0 = el.to_state()
            cmp = compare_twobody_j2(r0, v0, numeric_days * 86400, 120.0)
            row["j2_separation_km"] = cmp["final_sep_km"]
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


def validate_numerics(el: ClassicalElements) -> list[dict]:
    """Automatic numerical self-check of the propagators on the supplied orbit. Each row: name, value, threshold, passed."""
    r0, v0 = el.to_state(); T = el.period; rows = []
    def row(name, val, thr, unit="", cmp="<="):
        ok = val <= thr if cmp == "<=" else val >= thr
        rows.append({"check": name, "value": float(val), "threshold": float(thr), "unit": unit, "passed": bool(ok)})
    ref = kepler_propagate(r0, v0, T)[0]
    d853 = propagate(r0, v0, T, T / 4, "twobody", "dop853")
    row("DOP853 vs analytical Kepler, 1 orbit (position)", np.linalg.norm(d853.r[-1] - ref[:3]), 1e-4, "km")
    rk = propagate(r0, v0, T, T / 4, "twobody", "rk4", rk4_step_s=10.0)
    row("RK4 (10 s) vs analytical Kepler, 1 orbit (position)", np.linalg.norm(rk.r[-1] - ref[:3]), 0.5, "km")
    drift = invariants_drift(propagate(r0, v0, 5 * T, 30.0, "twobody", "dop853"))
    row("Two-body energy drift, 5 orbits (DOP853)", drift["energy_rel_drift"], 1e-8, "rel")
    row("Two-body angular-momentum drift, 5 orbits", drift["angmom_rel_drift"], 1e-8, "rel")
    j = invariants_drift(propagate(r0, v0, 5 * T, 30.0, "j2", "dop853"))
    row("J2 total-energy drift, 5 orbits (DOP853)", j["energy_rel_drift"], 1e-8, "rel")
    row("J2 h_z drift, 5 orbits (DOP853)", j["angmom_rel_drift"], 1e-8, "rel")
    cs = convergence_study(r0, v0, T)
    row("RK4 observed convergence order (expect ~4)", cs["rk4_observed_order"], 3.5, "", ">=")
    if el.i > 0.05 and el.i < math.pi - 0.05:
        c = compare_twobody_j2(r0, v0, 2 * 86400.0, 120.0)
        ana = c["raan_rate_analytical_deg_day"]
        row("J2 RAAN drift vs analytical (relative error)", abs(c["raan_rate_measured_deg_day"] - ana) / max(abs(ana), 1e-9), 0.02, "rel")
    return rows

"""Atmosphere model: US Standard Atmosphere 1976 (0-86 km geometric) blended into the
Vallado exponential table up to 1000+ km (scaled for continuity at the join).
Returns SI units. The upper table is a mean-solar-activity approximation, so orbital
lifetimes derived from it are order-of-magnitude estimates only."""
from __future__ import annotations
import math
import numpy as np

_RG = 6356.766                     # km, geopotential radius
_K = 34.163195                      # g0*M/R [K/km]
_H = [0.0, 11.0, 20.0, 32.0, 47.0, 51.0, 71.0, 84.852]
_T = [288.15, 216.65, 216.65, 228.65, 270.65, 270.65, 214.65, 186.946]
_L = [-6.5, 0.0, 1.0, 2.8, 0.0, -2.8, -2.0, 0.0]
_P = [101325.0]
for _i in range(1, len(_H)):
    _dh = _H[_i] - _H[_i - 1]
    if _L[_i - 1] == 0.0:
        _P.append(_P[-1] * math.exp(-_K * _dh / _T[_i - 1]))
    else:
        _P.append(_P[-1] * (_T[_i - 1] / (_T[_i - 1] + _L[_i - 1] * _dh)) ** (_K / _L[_i - 1]))

# Vallado exponential atmosphere: (base alt km, rho0 kg/m^3, scale height km)
_TAB = [(0, 1.225, 7.249), (25, 3.899e-2, 6.349), (30, 1.774e-2, 6.682), (40, 3.972e-3, 7.554),
        (50, 1.057e-3, 8.382), (60, 3.206e-4, 7.714), (70, 8.770e-5, 6.549), (80, 1.905e-5, 5.799),
        (90, 3.396e-6, 5.382), (100, 5.297e-7, 5.877), (110, 9.661e-8, 7.263), (120, 2.438e-8, 9.473),
        (130, 8.484e-9, 12.636), (140, 3.845e-9, 16.149), (150, 2.070e-9, 22.523), (180, 5.464e-10, 29.740),
        (200, 2.789e-10, 37.105), (250, 7.248e-11, 45.546), (300, 2.418e-11, 53.628), (350, 9.158e-12, 53.298),
        (400, 3.725e-12, 58.515), (450, 1.585e-12, 60.828), (500, 6.967e-13, 63.822), (600, 1.454e-13, 71.835),
        (700, 3.614e-14, 88.667), (800, 1.170e-14, 124.64), (900, 5.245e-15, 181.05), (1000, 3.019e-15, 268.0)]


def _tab_rho(h):
    row = _TAB[0]
    for r in _TAB:
        if h >= r[0]: row = r
        else: break
    return row[1] * math.exp(-(h - row[0]) / row[2])


def _us76(h_km):
    Hg = _RG * h_km / (_RG + h_km)
    i = 0
    while i < len(_H) - 1 and Hg >= _H[i + 1]: i += 1
    dh = Hg - _H[i]; L = _L[i]
    T = _T[i] + L * dh
    P = _P[i] * math.exp(-_K * dh / _T[i]) if L == 0.0 else _P[i] * (_T[i] / T) ** (_K / L)
    return P / (287.053 * T), P, T


_RHO86 = _us76(86.0)[0]
_SCALE = _RHO86 / _tab_rho(86.0)


def atmosphere(h_km: float):
    """(density kg/m^3, pressure Pa, temperature K, speed of sound m/s) at geometric altitude [km]."""
    h = max(float(h_km), 0.0)
    if h <= 86.0:
        rho, P, T = _us76(h)
    else:
        rho = _tab_rho(h) * _SCALE; T = 186.95; P = rho * 287.053 * T
    return rho, P, T, math.sqrt(1.4 * 287.053 * T)


def density(h_km):
    f = np.vectorize(lambda x: atmosphere(x)[0])
    out = f(h_km)
    return float(out) if np.ndim(out) == 0 else out

"""Ground track, target access (AOS/LOS), revisit statistics, sensor footprint and region coverage."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import numpy as np

from .constants import RE, DEG
from .frames import gmst_at, eci_to_ecef, ecef_to_geodetic, look_angles, geodetic_to_ecef


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GroundTarget:
    name: str
    lat_deg: float
    lon_deg: float
    alt_km: float = 0.0
    min_elev_deg: float = 10.0


def ground_track(t, r_eci, epoch: datetime) -> dict:
    """Sub-satellite points. Returns lat/lon [deg], geodetic altitude [km], and ECEF positions."""
    r_ecef = eci_to_ecef(r_eci, gmst_at(epoch, t))
    lat, lon, h = ecef_to_geodetic(r_ecef)
    return {"lat": np.degrees(lat), "lon": np.degrees(lon), "alt": h, "r_ecef": r_ecef}


def split_dateline(lon, lat):
    """Insert NaN at antimeridian jumps so line plots don't wrap across the map."""
    lon = np.asarray(lon, float); lat = np.asarray(lat, float)
    jumps = np.flatnonzero(np.abs(np.diff(lon)) > 180.0) + 1
    return np.insert(lon, jumps, np.nan), np.insert(lat, jumps, np.nan)


@dataclass
class Pass:
    aos_s: float
    los_s: float
    max_elev_deg: float
    t_max_s: float
    aos_az_deg: float
    los_az_deg: float
    clipped_start: bool = False
    clipped_end: bool = False

    @property
    def duration_s(self): return self.los_s - self.aos_s


def _cross_time(t0, t1, e0, e1, thr):
    return t0 + (thr - e0) / (e1 - e0) * (t1 - t0) if e1 != e0 else t0


def _refine_peak(t, r_ecef, rng, k, target):
    """Refine the time and value of peak elevation between samples (defect D4).

    Fits a parabola to slant-range^2 through samples k-1, k, k+1 (exact for straight-line relative motion,
    and the minimum range is very close to the maximum elevation for a pass), interpolates the ECEF position
    quadratically at the vertex and evaluates the elevation there. Falls back to the sample at the window edge."""
    n = len(t)
    if k == 0 or k == n - 1:
        return float(t[k]), float(np.degrees(look_angles(r_ecef[k], target.lat_deg * DEG, target.lon_deg * DEG, target.alt_km)[1]))
    k = max(1, min(n - 2, k))
    j = int(np.argmin(rng[k - 1:k + 2])) + k - 1          # centre the stencil on the minimum-range sample
    j = max(1, min(n - 2, j))
    tt = np.asarray(t[j - 1:j + 2], float); f = np.asarray(rng[j - 1:j + 2], float) ** 2
    c2, c1, _ = np.polyfit(tt - tt[1], f, 2)
    if c2 <= 0:
        tv = tt[1]
    else:
        tv = tt[1] + float(np.clip(-c1 / (2 * c2), tt[0] - tt[1], tt[2] - tt[1]))
    L = [np.prod([(tv - tt[m]) / (tt[q] - tt[m]) for m in range(3) if m != q]) for q in range(3)]
    rv = sum(L[q] * np.asarray(r_ecef[j - 1 + q], float) for q in range(3))
    el = look_angles(rv, target.lat_deg * DEG, target.lon_deg * DEG, target.alt_km)[1]
    return float(tv), float(np.degrees(el))


def compute_passes(t, r_ecef, target: GroundTarget) -> list[Pass]:
    """Contiguous intervals with elevation >= min_elev. AOS/LOS refined by linear interpolation of
    the elevation series (error << sampling step for dt <= ~30 s); window-edge passes are flagged as clipped."""
    az, el, rng = look_angles(r_ecef, target.lat_deg * DEG, target.lon_deg * DEG, target.alt_km)
    eld = np.degrees(el); azd = np.degrees(az); thr = target.min_elev_deg
    up = eld >= thr
    passes = []
    i = 0; n = len(t)
    while i < n:
        if not up[i]: i += 1; continue
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and up[j + 1]: j += 1
        cs, ce = i == 0, j == n - 1
        aos = t[i] if cs else _cross_time(t[i - 1], t[i], eld[i - 1], eld[i], thr)
        los = t[j] if ce else _cross_time(t[j], t[j + 1], eld[j], eld[j + 1], thr)
        k = i + int(np.argmax(eld[i:j + 1]))
        tmax, emax = _refine_peak(t, r_ecef, rng, k, target)
        passes.append(Pass(float(aos), float(los), float(max(emax, eld[k])), float(tmax), float(azd[i]), float(azd[j]), cs, ce))
        i = j + 1
    return passes


def revisit_stats(passes: list[Pass], duration_s: float) -> dict:
    """Gaps between consecutive passes (LOS -> next AOS) and window-based figures."""
    if not passes:
        return {"n_passes": 0, "mean_gap_s": None, "max_gap_s": None, "min_gap_s": None, "total_access_s": 0.0,
                "access_fraction": 0.0, "first_access_s": None}
    gaps = [passes[k + 1].aos_s - passes[k].los_s for k in range(len(passes) - 1)]
    total = sum(p.duration_s for p in passes)
    return {"n_passes": len(passes), "mean_gap_s": float(np.mean(gaps)) if gaps else None,
            "max_gap_s": float(np.max(gaps)) if gaps else None, "min_gap_s": float(np.min(gaps)) if gaps else None,
            "total_access_s": float(total), "access_fraction": float(total / duration_s), "first_access_s": passes[0].aos_s,
            "mean_duration_s": float(total / len(passes)), "max_elev_deg": float(max(p.max_elev_deg for p in passes))}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- footprint
def horizon_central_angle(alt_km, min_elev_deg=0.0):
    """Earth central angle [rad] to the edge of visibility at elevation >= min_elev (spherical Earth)."""
    el = min_elev_deg * DEG
    return np.arccos(RE * np.cos(el) / (RE + np.asarray(alt_km, float))) - el


def sensor_central_angle(alt_km, half_fov_deg):
    """Earth central angle [rad] seen by a nadir-pointing sensor of half-angle `half_fov_deg`
    (clamped at the horizon when the sensor sees past the limb). Spherical Earth."""
    alt = np.asarray(alt_km, float); eta = half_fov_deg * DEG
    s = (RE + alt) / RE * np.sin(eta)
    lam = np.arcsin(np.clip(s, -1, 1)) - eta
    return np.where(s >= 1.0, horizon_central_angle(alt, 0.0), lam)


def swath_width_km(alt_km, half_fov_deg):
    return 2.0 * RE * sensor_central_angle(alt_km, half_fov_deg)


@dataclass
class CoverageResult:
    lat: np.ndarray               # grid latitudes (flat), deg
    lon: np.ndarray
    weights: np.ndarray           # cos(lat) area weights
    covered_ever: np.ndarray      # bool per grid point
    n_events: np.ndarray          # distinct coverage intervals per point
    max_gap_s: np.ndarray         # longest gap (s) per point (nan if never covered)
    first_cover_s: np.ndarray
    t: np.ndarray
    cum_fraction: np.ndarray      # area-weighted covered fraction vs time

    @property
    def grid_axes(self):
        """(unique lats, unique lons) so flat arrays can be reshaped to (len(lats), len(lons))."""
        return np.unique(self.lat), np.unique(self.lon)

    @property
    def coverage_fraction(self): return float(np.sum(self.weights * self.covered_ever) / np.sum(self.weights))
    @property
    def mean_revisit_s(self):
        g = self.max_gap_s[~np.isnan(self.max_gap_s)]
        return float(np.mean(g)) if g.size else None


def region_coverage(t, sub_lat_deg, sub_lon_deg, alt_km, region, half_fov_deg=None, min_elev_deg=None,
                    grid_deg=2.0, max_cells=4_000_000, max_work=2_000_000_000) -> CoverageResult:
    """Simplified coverage: a grid point is covered when its central angle to the sub-satellite point
    is <= the sensor (or elevation-limited) footprint angle. Spherical-Earth geometry; nadir pointing.

    region = (lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, lon_max) deg. Every output time sample is used: the (time x cell)
    boolean matrix is built in chunks of grid cells so that no chunk exceeds `max_cells` elements.
    (Earlier versions silently dropped time samples above that budget, which under-reported coverage; D2.)
    Raises ValueError if time x cells exceeds `max_work`, instead of returning a degraded answer."""
    la0, la1, lo0, lo1 = region
    if not (la0 < la1 and lo0 < lo1): raise ValueError("Region must satisfy lat_min<lat_max and lon_min<lon_max.")
    if half_fov_deg is None and min_elev_deg is None: raise ValueError("Provide half_fov_deg or min_elev_deg.")
    lats = np.arange(la0 + grid_deg / 2, la1, grid_deg); lons = np.arange(lo0 + grid_deg / 2, lo1, grid_deg)
    if lats.size == 0 or lons.size == 0: raise ValueError("Grid resolution too coarse for the region.")
    LA, LO = np.meshgrid(lats, lons, indexing="ij"); LA, LO = LA.ravel(), LO.ravel()
    G = LA.size
    ts = np.asarray(t, float); T = ts.size
    if T * G > max_work:
        raise ValueError(f"Coverage needs {T} time samples x {G} grid cells = {T*G:.2e} evaluations "
                         f"(limit {max_work:.1e}). Use a coarser grid, a smaller region, a larger step or a shorter duration.")
    slat = np.radians(np.asarray(sub_lat_deg, float)); slon = np.radians(np.asarray(sub_lon_deg, float))
    alt = np.asarray(alt_km, float)
    lam = sensor_central_angle(alt, half_fov_deg) if half_fov_deg is not None else horizon_central_angle(alt, min_elev_deg)
    coslam = np.cos(lam)[:, None]
    gla, glo = np.radians(LA), np.radians(LO)
    g = np.stack((np.cos(gla) * np.cos(glo), np.cos(gla) * np.sin(glo), np.sin(gla)), axis=1)
    s = np.stack((np.cos(slat) * np.cos(slon), np.cos(slat) * np.sin(slon), np.sin(slat)), axis=1)
    w = np.cos(gla)
    dt = float(np.median(np.diff(ts))) if T > 1 else 0.0
    covered = np.zeros(G, bool); rising = np.zeros(G, int)
    first = np.full(G, np.nan); maxgap = np.full(G, np.nan)
    chunk = max(1, int(max_cells // max(T, 1)))
    for c0 in range(0, G, chunk):
        sl = slice(c0, min(G, c0 + chunk))
        cov = (s @ g[sl].T) >= coslam                                # (T, C)
        anyc = cov.any(axis=0)
        covered[sl] = anyc
        rising[sl] = (np.diff(cov.astype(np.int8), axis=0) == 1).sum(axis=0) + cov[0].astype(int)
        f = np.where(anyc, ts[np.argmax(cov, axis=0)], np.nan)

    """Small-circle outline (lat, lon in deg) of angular radius `central_angle_rad` about a point on a sphere."""
    la, lo = np.radians(lat_deg), np.radians(lon_deg); lam = float(central_angle_rad)

    return np.degrees(lat2), (np.degrees(lon2) + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0

def estimate_lifetime_days(alt_km: float, area_to_mass_m2kg: float = 0.01, cd: float = 2.2, reentry_alt_km: float = 120.0):
    """Circular-orbit decay lifetime [days] from da/dt = -rho*B*sqrt(mu*a) (B = Cd*A/m), integrated in altitude.
    Uses a mean-solar-activity exponential atmosphere: accuracy is order-of-magnitude (factor of several)."""
    B = cd * area_to_mass_m2kg
    if alt_km <= reentry_alt_km: return 0.0
    total = 0.0; h = alt_km
    while h > reentry_alt_km:
        hm = h - 0.5
        rho = _tab_rho(hm) * _SCALE
        adot = rho * B * math.sqrt(MU * (RE + hm)) * 1e3           # km/s
        total += 1.0 / adot                                          # seconds per km
        h -= 1.0
        if total / 86400 > 36500: return float("inf")

    n = math.sqrt(MU / a**3); r = j2_secular_rates(a, e, i)

    for d in range(1, max_days + 1):

        return {"corridor_deg": None, "in_corridor": None, "distance_deg": None}
    return {"corridor_deg": cor, "in_corridor": bool(_az_in(azimuth_deg, *cor)), "distance_deg": float(_az_dist(azimuth_deg, *cor))}


def choose_branch(site, incl_deg: float, v_orb_kms: float, branch: str = "auto") -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Pick the azimuth branch. 'north'/'south' are honoured as given. 'auto' picks the branch inside (or
    closest to) the site's corridor; with no corridor data it picks the south branch for retrograde/polar
    orbits (i >= 90 deg) and the north branch otherwise, and says so. Returns (branch, reason)."""
    if branch in ("north", "south"):
        return branch, "chosen by user"
    cor = RANGE_CORRIDORS.get(getattr(site, "name", None))
    azs = {b: rotating_azimuth(incl_deg, site.lat_deg, v_orb_kms, b) for b in ("north", "south")}
    if azs["north"] is None:
        return "north", "infeasible"
    if cor is not None:
        dn, ds = _az_dist(azs["north"], *cor), _az_dist(azs["south"], *cor)
        b = "south" if ds < dn else "north"
        return b, f"closest to the approximate {cor[0]:.0f}-{cor[1]:.0f} deg corridor for {site.name}"
    b = "south" if incl_deg >= 90.0 else "north"
    return b, "no corridor data for this site; default branch for this inclination"


def analytical_launch(lat_deg, alt_km, incl_deg, vehicle: Vehicle | None = None, losses_kms: float = 1.0, branch: str = "north"):
    """First-order launch budget for a circular target orbit.

    required = orbital-velocity vector change (Earth-rotation credit included)
             + climb term (energy-equivalent speed minus circular speed, grows with altitude)
             + `losses_kms`, a *typical-value assumption* for drag, steering and gravity-turn inefficiency
    (the ascent simulation reports the actual losses for a given vehicle)."""
    r = RE + alt_km; v = circular_velocity(r)
    beta = inertial_azimuth(incl_deg, lat_deg, branch)
    out = {"v_circ_kms": v, "feasible": beta is not None, "min_inclination_deg": abs(lat_deg),
           "site_speed_kms": OMEGA_E * RE * math.cos(lat_deg * DEG)}
    if beta is None:
        out["message"] = (f"Direct launch to i={incl_deg:.1f} deg from latitude {lat_deg:.1f} deg is impossible "
                          f"(minimum {abs(lat_deg):.1f} deg without a dog-leg manoeuvre).")
        return out
    b = beta * DEG; vs = out["site_speed_kms"]
    dv_ideal = math.hypot(v * math.sin(b) - vs, v * math.cos(b))
    v_eq = math.sqrt(2 * MU * (1 / RE - 1 / (2 * r)))
    climb = v_eq - v
    out.update(climb_term_kms=climb, inertial_azimuth_deg=beta, relative_azimuth_deg=rotating_azimuth(incl_deg, lat_deg, v, branch), azimuth_branch=branch,
               rotation_benefit_kms=v - dv_ideal, dv_ideal_kms=dv_ideal, dv_losses_assumed_kms=losses_kms,
               dv_required_kms=dv_ideal + climb + losses_kms)
    if vehicle is not None:
        stages = vehicle.stage_delta_vs()
        out.update(stage_dv_kms=stages, vehicle_dv_kms=sum(stages), margin_kms=sum(stages) - out["dv_required_kms"])
        lo, hi = 0.0, 5 * vehicle.liftoff_mass
        def margin(pl):
            return sum(replace(vehicle, payload_kg=pl).stage_delta_vs()) - out["dv_required_kms"]
        if margin(0.0) < 0: out["max_payload_kg"] = 0.0
        else:
            for _ in range(60):
                mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
                lo, hi = (mid, hi) if margin(mid) >= 0 else (lo, mid)
            out["max_payload_kg"] = lo
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ascent simulation
def _cd(mach: float) -> float:
    if mach < 0.8: return 0.30
    if mach < 1.2: return 0.30 + (mach - 0.8) / 0.4 * 0.25 if mach < 1.0 else 0.55 - (mach - 1.0) / 0.2 * 0.05
    return max(0.22, 0.50 - 0.10 * (mach - 1.2))


def _enu(r):
    up = r / np.linalg.norm(r)
    east = np.cross([0, 0, 1.0], up); east /= np.linalg.norm(east)
    return east, np.cross(up, east), up


class _Ascent:
    def __init__(self, veh: Vehicle, prog: AscentProgram):
        self.veh, self.prog = veh, prog
        self.k = 0; self.t_ign = 0.0; self.gamma_sep = 0.0; self.thrusting = True

    def thrust_dir(self, t, r, v):
        east, north, up = _enu(r)
        az = math.radians(self.prog.azimuth_deg)
        az_dir = math.sin(az) * east + math.cos(az) * north
        if self.k == 0:
            if t < self.prog.vertical_time_s: return up
            vrel = v - np.cross(_W, r); sp = np.linalg.norm(vrel)
            if sp < 1e-3: return up
            vh = vrel / sp
            d = self.prog.kick_angle_deg * DEG if t < self.prog.vertical_time_s + self.prog.kick_duration_s else 0.0
            hh = az_dir - np.dot(az_dir, vh) * vh; hn = np.linalg.norm(hh)
            if d == 0.0 or hn < 1e-9: return vh
            return math.cos(d) * vh + math.sin(d) * hh / hn
        vh = v - np.dot(v, up) * up; n = np.linalg.norm(vh)
        h_dir = vh / n if n > 1e-6 else az_dir
        st = self.veh.stages[self.k]
        frac = min(1.0, max(0.0, (t - self.t_ign) / (self.prog.upper_ramp_fraction * st.burn_time)))
        e = self.gamma_sep + (self.prog.upper_pitch_end_deg * DEG - self.gamma_sep) * frac
        return math.cos(e) * h_dir + math.sin(e) * up

    def forces(self, t, y):
        """Returns (a_total, a_thrust_vec, a_drag_vec, rho, q_pa, mach)."""
        r, v, m = y[:3], y[3:6], y[6]
        rn = np.linalg.norm(r); alt = rn - RE
        a_g = -MU * r / rn**3
        if self.prog.use_j2:
            z2 = 5 * r[2] ** 2 / rn**2
            a_g = a_g + 1.5 * J2 * MU * RE**2 / rn**5 * np.array([r[0] * (z2 - 1), r[1] * (z2 - 1), r[2] * (z2 - 3)])
        rho, P, T, cs = atmosphere(alt)
        vrel = v - np.cross(_W, r); vr = np.linalg.norm(vrel)
        mach = vr * 1000.0 / cs
        a_d = -0.5 * rho * self.veh.cd_scale * _cd(mach) * self.veh.ref_area_m2 / m * 1e3 * vr * vrel
        a_t = np.zeros(3)
        if self.thrusting:
            st = self.veh.stages[self.k]
            T_kn = st.thrust_vac_kn - (st.thrust_vac_kn - st.thrust_sl_kn) * min(1.0, P / 101325.0)
            a_t = T_kn / m * self.thrust_dir(t, r, v)
        q = 0.5 * rho * (vr * 1000.0) ** 2
        return a_g + a_t + a_d, a_t, a_d, rho, q, mach

    def rhs(self, t, y):
        a = self.forces(t, y)[0]
        md = -self.veh.stages[self.k].mdot if self.thrusting else 0.0
        return np.concatenate((y[3:6], a, [md]))


@dataclass
class LaunchResult:
    epoch: datetime
    site: LaunchSite
    vehicle: Vehicle
    program: AscentProgram
    t: np.ndarray
    samples: dict
    events: list
    status: str
    reached_target_energy: bool
    burnout_r: np.ndarray
    burnout_v: np.ndarray
    burnout_mass_kg: float
    burnout_time_s: float
    summary: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def burnout_epoch(self): return self.epoch + timedelta(seconds=self.burnout_time_s)

    @property
    def burnout_elements(self):
        try: return rv_to_coe(self.burnout_r, self.burnout_v)
        except OrbitError: return None

    def handoff(self) -> dict:
        """State to feed straight into `propagate` (epoch, ECI r/v, elements or None if not bound)."""
        return {"epoch": self.burnout_epoch, "r": self.burnout_r, "v": self.burnout_v, "elements": self.burnout_elements}


def simulate_ascent(vehicle: Vehicle, site: LaunchSite, program: AscentProgram, epoch: datetime,
                    cutoff_a_km: float | None = None, dt_out: float = 1.0, rtol: float = 1e-9) -> LaunchResult:
    """Integrate the powered ascent. If `cutoff_a_km` is given the last stage is shut down (guided cutoff)
    as soon as the osculating semi-major axis reaches it; otherwise it burns to propellant depletion."""
    s0 = vehicle.stages[0]
    m0 = vehicle.liftoff_mass
    if s0.thrust_sl_kn * 1000.0 / (m0 * G0) <= 1.0:
        raise LaunchError(f"Liftoff thrust-to-weight is {s0.thrust_sl_kn*1000/(m0*G0):.2f} (<= 1): vehicle cannot lift off.")
    th0 = float(gmst_at(epoch, 0.0))
    r0 = ecef_to_eci(geodetic_to_ecef(site.lat_deg * DEG, site.lon_deg * DEG, site.alt_km), th0)
    v0 = np.cross(_W, r0)
    y = np.concatenate((r0, v0, [m0])); t = 0.0
    sim = _Ascent(vehicle, program)
    T_list, Y_list, K_list, TI_list, TH_list = [], [], [], [], []
    events = [(0.0, "Liftoff")]; status = "Burnout (propellant depleted)"; reached = False
    eps_target = -MU / (2 * cutoff_a_km) if cutoff_a_km else None
    impact = lambda tt, yy: np.linalg.norm(yy[:3]) - RE + 0.2
    impact.terminal = True; impact.direction = -1
    n = len(vehicle.stages)

    def run(t_start, y_start, t_end, ev, k, thrusting, t_ign):
        sim.k, sim.thrusting, sim.t_ign = k, thrusting, t_ign
        grid = np.arange(t_start, t_end, dt_out)
        grid = np.append(grid, t_end) if grid.size == 0 or grid[-1] < t_end - 1e-9 else grid
        sol = solve_ivp(sim.rhs, (t_start, t_end), y_start, method="DOP853", t_eval=grid, events=ev,
                        rtol=rtol, atol=np.array([1e-9] * 3 + [1e-12] * 3 + [1e-6]))
        if not sol.success: raise RuntimeError(f"Ascent integration failed: {sol.message}")
        tt, yy = list(sol.t), list(sol.y.T)
        hit = None
        for e in sol.t_events:
            if len(e):
                hit = (e[0], sol.y_events[[i for i, x in enumerate(sol.t_events) if len(x)][0]][0]); break
        if hit is not None:
            if hit[0] > tt[-1] + 1e-9: tt.append(hit[0]); yy.append(hit[1])
            else: tt[-1], yy[-1] = hit[0], hit[1]
        for q, w in zip(tt, yy):
            T_list.append(q); Y_list.append(w); K_list.append(k if thrusting else -1)
            TI_list.append(t_ign); TH_list.append(sim.gamma_sep)
        return tt[-1], yy[-1], hit

    for k, st in enumerate(vehicle.stages):
        up = y[:3] / np.linalg.norm(y[:3])
        sim.gamma_sep = math.asin(np.clip(np.dot(y[3:6], up) / max(np.linalg.norm(y[3:6]), 1e-9), -1, 1))
        events.append((t, f"{st.name} ignition"))
        last = k == n - 1
        ev = [impact]
        if last and eps_target is not None:
            def cut(tt, yy, e=eps_target): return 0.5 * np.dot(yy[3:6], yy[3:6]) - MU / np.linalg.norm(yy[:3]) - e
            cut.terminal = True; cut.direction = 1; ev.append(cut)
        t_end = t + st.burn_time
        t_new, y_new, hit = run(t, y, t_end, ev, k, True, t)
        t, y = t_new, y_new
        if hit is not None:
            if np.linalg.norm(y[:3]) - RE < 0.5:
                status = "FAILURE: vehicle impacted the ground during ascent"; events.append((t, "Ground impact")); break
            reached = True; status = "Guided cutoff: target energy reached"
            events.append((t, f"{st.name} guided cutoff (target energy)")); break
        events.append((t, f"{st.name} burnout"))
        if not last:
            y = y.copy(); y[6] -= st.dry_mass_kg
            events.append((t, f"{st.name} separation"))
            t_new, y, hit = run(t, y, t + program.stage_coast_s, [impact], k + 1, False, t)
            t = t_new
            if hit is not None:
                status = "FAILURE: vehicle impacted the ground during staging coast"; events.append((t, "Ground impact")); break

    Tt, Yy = np.array(T_list), np.array(Y_list)
    samples = _derive(sim, Tt, Yy, np.array(K_list), np.array(TI_list), np.array(TH_list), epoch, site)
    res = LaunchResult(epoch, site, vehicle, program, Tt, samples, events, status, reached,
                       Yy[-1, :3].copy(), Yy[-1, 3:6].copy(), float(Yy[-1, 6]), float(Tt[-1]))
    res.summary = _summarise(res, m0)
    return res


def _derive(sim, T, Y, K, TI, TH, epoch, site):
    n = len(T)
    q = np.zeros(n); mach = np.zeros(n); gload = np.zeros(n); drag = np.zeros(n)
    for i in range(n):
        sim.k = max(K[i], 0); sim.thrusting = K[i] >= 0; sim.t_ign = TI[i]; sim.gamma_sep = TH[i]
        _, at, ad, rho, qq, mc = sim.forces(T[i], Y[i])
        q[i], mach[i] = qq, mc
        gload[i] = np.linalg.norm(at + ad) * 1000.0 / G0
        drag[i] = np.linalg.norm(ad) * 1000.0 / G0
    r, v = Y[:, :3], Y[:, 3:6]
    rn = np.linalg.norm(r, axis=1)
    th = gmst_at(epoch, T)
    lat, lon, h = ecef_to_geodetic(eci_to_ecef(r, th))
    vrel = v - np.cross(_W, r)
    up = r / rn[:, None]
    fpa_in = np.degrees(np.arcsin(np.clip(np.sum(v * up, axis=1) / np.linalg.norm(v, axis=1), -1, 1)))
    la0, lo0 = site.lat_deg * DEG, site.lon_deg * DEG
    cosd = np.sin(la0) * np.sin(lat) + np.cos(la0) * np.cos(lat) * np.cos(lon - lo0)
    eps = 0.5 * np.sum(v * v, axis=1) - MU / rn
    return {"t": T, "r": r, "v": v, "mass": Y[:, 6], "alt_km": rn - RE, "lat_deg": np.degrees(lat), "lon_deg": np.degrees(lon),
            "speed_rel_kms": np.linalg.norm(vrel, axis=1), "speed_inertial_kms": np.linalg.norm(v, axis=1),
            "fpa_deg": fpa_in, "q_kpa": q / 1000.0, "mach": mach, "accel_g": gload, "drag_g": drag,
            "downrange_km": RE * np.arccos(np.clip(cosd, -1, 1)), "stage": K, "sma_km": -MU / (2 * eps)}


def _summarise(res: LaunchResult, m0: float) -> dict:
    s = res.samples; i = int(np.argmax(s["q_kpa"]))
    el = res.burnout_elements
    dv_used = 0.0
    # delta-v actually bought by the engines (Tsiolkovsky with effective Isp over thrusting samples)
    mass = s["mass"]; k = s["stage"]
    for j in range(1, len(mass)):
        if k[j] >= 0 and mass[j] < mass[j - 1]:
            st = res.vehicle.stages[k[j]]
            P = atmosphere(s["alt_km"][j])[1]
            T = st.thrust_vac_kn - (st.thrust_vac_kn - st.thrust_sl_kn) * min(1.0, P / 101325.0)
            dv_used += T * 1000.0 / st.mdot / 1000.0 * math.log(mass[j - 1] / mass[j])
    gain = float(np.linalg.norm(s["v"][-1] - s["v"][0]))   # vector velocity change
    prop_used = float(sum(mass[j - 1] - mass[j] for j in range(1, len(mass)) if k[j] >= 0))
    out = {"burnout_time_s": res.burnout_time_s, "burnout_alt_km": float(s["alt_km"][-1]),
           "burnout_speed_inertial_kms": float(s["speed_inertial_kms"][-1]), "burnout_fpa_deg": float(s["fpa_deg"][-1]),
           "downrange_km": float(s["downrange_km"][-1]), "max_q_kpa": float(s["q_kpa"][i]), "max_q_time_s": float(s["t"][i]),
           "max_q_alt_km": float(s["alt_km"][i]), "max_accel_g": float(np.max(s["accel_g"])),
           "propellant_used_kg": prop_used,
           "burnout_mass_kg": res.burnout_mass_kg, "engine_dv_kms": dv_used, "velocity_gain_kms": float(gain),
           "total_losses_kms": float(dv_used - gain), "reached_target_energy": res.reached_target_energy,
           "launch_azimuth_deg": float(res.program.azimuth_deg % 360.0),
           "heading": "north-going" if math.cos(res.program.azimuth_deg * DEG) >= 0 else "south-going"}
    out.update(corridor_check(res.site, res.program.azimuth_deg))
    if el is not None:
        out.update(perigee_alt_km=el.perigee_alt, apogee_alt_km=el.apogee_alt, inclination_deg=math.degrees(el.i),
                   eccentricity=el.e, sma_km=el.a)
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- guidance tuning
def tune_ascent(vehicle: Vehicle, site: LaunchSite, target_alt_km: float, incl_deg: float, epoch: datetime,
                base: AscentProgram | None = None, branch: str = "auto"):
    """Find (kick angle, upper-stage end pitch, azimuth) so a guided cutoff lands on a circular orbit of the target altitude.
    `branch` = 'auto' | 'north' | 'south' selects the azimuth branch (see choose_branch).
    Returns (program, LaunchResult, converged: bool)."""
    a_t = RE + target_alt_km
    br, _ = choose_branch(site, incl_deg, circular_velocity(a_t), branch)
    az = rotating_azimuth(incl_deg, site.lat_deg, circular_velocity(a_t), br)
    if az is None:
        raise LaunchError(f"Inclination {incl_deg:.1f} deg is unreachable from latitude {site.lat_deg:.1f} deg.")
    base = replace(base or AscentProgram(), azimuth_deg=az)

    def prog_of(x):
        return replace(base, kick_angle_deg=x[0], upper_pitch_end_deg=x[1], azimuth_deg=x[2])

    def resid(x):
        try: r = simulate_ascent(vehicle, site, prog_of(x), epoch, cutoff_a_km=a_t, dt_out=5.0, rtol=1e-7)
        except Exception: return [1e3, 1e3, 1e3]
        s = r.summary
        if not r.reached_target_energy or "inclination_deg" not in s:
            return [1e2, 1e2, 1e2]
        return [(s["burnout_alt_km"] - target_alt_km) / 10.0, s["burnout_fpa_deg"], s["inclination_deg"] - incl_deg]

    best = None
    for x0 in ([1.2, -10.0], [1.0, 0.0], [1.4, -20.0], [0.9, -5.0], [1.6, -25.0]):
        sol = least_squares(resid, x0 + [base.azimuth_deg], bounds=([0.2, -60.0, 0.0], [3.0, 40.0, 360.0]),
                            diff_step=1e-2, xtol=1e-8, ftol=1e-8, max_nfev=60)
        if best is None or sol.cost < best.cost: best = sol
        if best.cost < 1e-3: break
    prog = prog_of(best.x)
    result = simulate_ascent(vehicle, site, prog, epoch, cutoff_a_km=a_t)
    s = result.summary
    ok = (result.reached_target_energy and abs(s["burnout_alt_km"] - target_alt_km) < 0.05 * target_alt_km + 10
          and abs(s["burnout_fpa_deg"]) < 0.5 and abs(s.get("inclination_deg", 999) - incl_deg) < 0.3)
    return prog, result, bool(ok)

"""Integration layer: one MissionConfig in, one MissionResult out. Independent of any UI."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

from .elements import ClassicalElements, rv_to_coe
from .propagators import propagate, invariants_drift, PropagationResult
from .frames import gmst_at
from .groundtrack import GroundTarget, ground_track, compute_passes, revisit_stats, region_coverage, CoverageResult
from .intelligence import evaluate_orbit, Assessment
from .analysis import orbit_summary, osculating_series

DEFAULT_EPOCH = datetime(2026, 11, 17, 0, 0, 0)


@dataclass
class MissionConfig:
    name: str = "Mission-1"
    elements: ClassicalElements = field(default_factory=lambda: ClassicalElements.from_altitudes(600, 600, 97.8))
    epoch: datetime = DEFAULT_EPOCH
    duration_h: float = 24.0
    dt_s: float = 30.0
    model: str = "j2"
    method: str = "dop853"
    targets: tuple = ()
    half_fov_deg: float | None = 30.0
    region: tuple | None = None            # (lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, lon_max)
    grid_deg: float = 2.0
    area_to_mass: float = 0.01
    launch_site: object = None
    state0: tuple | None = None            # optional (r, v) ECI override, e.g. a launch burnout state

    def validate(self):
        if not (0 < self.duration_h <= 24 * 30): raise ValueError("Duration must be within (0, 720] hours.")
        if not (1.0 <= self.dt_s <= 600.0): raise ValueError("Time step must be within [1, 600] s.")
        n = self.duration_h * 3600 / self.dt_s
        if n > 200_000: raise ValueError(f"{n:.0f} output samples requested; increase the step or shorten the duration (max 200000).")


@dataclass
class MissionResult:
    config: MissionConfig
    prop: PropagationResult
    summary: dict
    track: dict
    passes: dict
    revisit: dict
    coverage: CoverageResult | None
    assessment: Assessment
    invariants: dict
    osculating: dict

    @property
    def epoch(self): return self.config.epoch


def run_mission(cfg: MissionConfig) -> MissionResult:
    cfg.validate()
    r0, v0 = cfg.state0 if cfg.state0 is not None else cfg.elements.to_state()
    el0 = rv_to_coe(r0, v0)
    duration = cfg.duration_h * 3600.0
    prop = propagate(r0, v0, duration, cfg.dt_s, cfg.model, cfg.method)
    track = ground_track(prop.t, prop.r, cfg.epoch)
    passes = {t.name: compute_passes(prop.t, track["r_ecef"], t) for t in cfg.targets}
    revisit = {n: revisit_stats(p, duration) for n, p in passes.items()}
    cov = None
    if cfg.region is not None and cfg.half_fov_deg:
        cov = region_coverage(prop.t, track["lat"], track["lon"], track["alt"], cfg.region, half_fov_deg=cfg.half_fov_deg, grid_deg=cfg.grid_deg)
    assess = evaluate_orbit(el0, cfg.targets, cfg.half_fov_deg, cfg.launch_site, cfg.area_to_mass)
    stride = max(1, len(prop.t) // 600)
    osc = osculating_series(prop.y[::stride]); osc["t"] = prop.t[::stride]
    return MissionResult(cfg, prop, orbit_summary(el0), track, passes, revisit, cov, assess, invariants_drift(prop), osc)


def config_from_launch(launch, base: MissionConfig) -> MissionConfig:
    """Hand-off: burnout epoch + ECI state become the initial condition of the orbit propagation."""
    h = launch.handoff()
    if h["elements"] is None:
        raise ValueError("Burnout state is not on a bound orbit; nothing to propagate.")
    return replace(base, epoch=h["epoch"], elements=h["elements"], state0=(h["r"], h["v"]), launch_site=launch.site)
